Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a transparent HD painted sprite sheet with exactly THREE columns and ONE row, one isolated effect per column. The input is original pixel-art source reference ONLY. Repaint ONLY the source shapes labelled source 57, source 58 and source 59 in the reference (top row fourth cell, bottom row first cell, bottom row second cell). Ignore the other five reference cells.
Each of these three source sprites consists of exactly TWO small floating cyan-blue flame curls near the top and ONE very flat thin horizontal pale-blue elliptical outline ring below. Keep their distinct source shapes and relative positions. The two upper curls float in empty transparent air. They do NOT grow out of the ring. Paint the delicate flat ring as a simple narrow luminous outline, without a solid interior platform. Keep the oval interior transparent.
Clean hand-painted arcade style, bright cyan edges and deep blue interior brush strokes, smooth high resolution.
